Name: Expanded Silos
Author: TheVypR
Description:
A small Content Patcher mod to improve the silos without making it too overpowered or taking away from the vanilla experience.

'Big Silo': Costs 1000g, 200 stone, 20 clay, and 5 gold bars. Is built on top of a Silo, and provides storage for 480 hay (2x the vanilla silo) by default.

'Deluxe Silo': Costs 10,000g, 350 stone, 50 clay, and 5 iridium bars. Is built on top of a Big Silo, and provides storage for 960 hay (4x the vanilla silo) by default.



If you have different assets you want to use, name the files to match the files you want to replace EXACTLY and put those files in the assets folder (assets/seasonal for seasonal assets).
